title: Trap the opposing king in one move.
goal: Trap the opposing king in one move.
narration_seed: The game ends when the opposing king is under attack and has no way to escape.
hints: Move the rook across the top row so it attacks the opposing king, while the queen covers every escape square.
solution_text: Move your rook from the square a1 to the square a8 to trap the black king with no escape.
success_text: You trapped the opposing king with no escape in one move.
failure_text: Look for a rook move that attacks the king and removes every escape square.
